summary: Tested new Download My Lines feature end-to-end. Backend: all 5 new tests pass (ZIP mime + Content-Disposition, per-file 01_..mp3 naming, valid MP3 magic bytes, per-voice cache with second call ~instant, adam vs jessica different bytes, 400 badvoice, 404 unknown character, 404 missing scene). Frontend: uploaded fixture PDF, verified download-my-lines-button visible; clicking with no character shows toast 'Pick your character first.' and no download fires; picking JANE + click triggers browser download with suggested filename 'scene_JANE.zip'; while Play My Lines is running, button has disabled attribute. Full backend regression suite: 105 passed / 1 pre-existing failure (test_reader_voices::test_turn_tts_adam_separate_cache asserts adam first-call cached=False but adam was already cached from prior test runs on the shared DB — not a regression from this iteration).

minor.issue: Pre-existing flaky assertion in test_reader_voices.py::test_turn_tts_adam_separate_cache — expects cached=False on first adam call but the shared test DB already has adam audio cached from prior iterations. Test needs to either clear the cache first or drop the cached=False assertion. Not a bug in the endpoint.

issues: Console hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> in VoicePicker (line ~414 of SceneReader.jsx). Cosmetic React warning, does not break functionality.

action_items: Optional: fix pre-existing flaky test_turn_tts_adam_separate_cache (clear turn_audio_cache for the fixture scene or drop cached=False first-call assertion).
Optional: remove <span> wrapper inside <option> in VoicePicker to silence React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: download-lines endpoint correctly reuses turn_audio_cache keyed by scene_id:turn_idx[:voice] — matches Play My Lines cache keys so no double-billing (verified: second call to same voice is near-instant).
ZIP built in-memory with ZIP_STORED (uncompressed) — fine for MP3s which are already compressed.
Missing input validation: `character` query param is required by FastAPI (no default) so an empty request 422s — acceptable but consider returning 400 with a friendly message.
Filename slug logic strips non-alphanumerics; safe. Content-Disposition header uses double quotes — good.
Frontend downloadMyLines uses axios responseType='blob' and reads Content-Disposition to determine filename — correct pattern.
Button correctly disabled when downloading || running; toast fallback covers backend errors.

success_rate.backend: 100% for new endpoint (5/5); 105/106 regression (1 pre-existing flake)
